name: tripo-3d
description: Generate textured, rig-ready 3D models from a text prompt or a reference image with Tripo, and export GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF straight into your project. Connect your China-mainland Tripo account once in the browser (OAuth), no API key pasting.

description_i18n.en: Generate textured, rig-ready 3D models from a text prompt or a reference image with Tripo, and export GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF straight into your project. Connect your China-mainland Tripo account once in the browser (OAuth), no API key pasting.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用 Tripo 从一句话或一张图生成带贴图、可绑骨的 3D 模型，支持动画、减面与 GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF 导出，文件直接落到项目里。浏览器里授权一次国内站 Tripo 账号即可使用，无需粘贴 API Key。
